name: ryu.desktop
description: An interactive virtual desktop for any Ryu node — cloud-managed, self-hosted, or local. The sidecar brings up a full headless Linux desktop (Xvfb + window manager + apps) with a VNC server on loopback, exposes it through Core's generic WebSocket ext-proxy, and the desktop Virtual Desktop panel streams it live with mouse/keyboard input. Ghost can drive the same display, so agents see and control exactly what you watch.
